## Scrape Y Combinator Startup Founders with Direct Personal LinkedIn & X/Twitter Links
**Powered by StoreIntel Labs on Apify:** [Y Combinator (YC) Startups & Founders Scraper: LinkedIn, X & Batch Data](https://apify.com/storeintel/y-combinator-startups-founders-scraper)

Extract structured Y Combinator startup profiles (batch, status, team headcount, website, tags) and emit individual founder B2B lead records with direct personal LinkedIn and X/Twitter URLs.

### Quick Setup (30 seconds)
1. Get your free Apify API token at `https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations`.
2. Open the **Run StoreIntel Apify Actor** node and paste your token in the `Authorization` header (`Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`).
3. Customize the JSON input body or connect it to your Google Sheet / Webhook trigger.

### Pre-Configured Apify Task Templates
- [YC Founder LinkedIn & X/Twitter B2B Leads Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/yc-founder-linkedin-twitter-b2b-leads-scraper)
- [Y Combinator AI Startups & Batch Directory Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/y-combinator-w24-s24-ai-startups-directory-scraper)
- [YC Startup Team Size, Website & Socials Scraper](https://apify.com/storeintel/yc-startup-team-size-hiring-status-scraper)
